metadata.purpose: Canonical decision contract for three-dragon formation recommendations.
metadata.policy: Hard eligibility and evidence constraints are applied before comparative judgment. Strategic weights remain scenario-dependent and are not a universal tier score.

required_context.unknown_policy: Proceed with explicit assumptions when missing inputs do not prevent a useful conditional answer; identify the single missing input most likely to reverse the result.

decision_flow.rule: Remove unowned dragons, locked Habits, unavailable Vanguard effects, and content excluded by lifecycle policy before assigning synergy or counter credit.

Define the objective and, for counters, inventory material enemy threat instances by source, damage category, trigger, timing, target scope, and exclusions. A general-purpose meta evaluation does not require a named opponent; assess broad formation value and explicitly state the opposing troop type that has advantage over the selected shared troop.

Do not stop at the first plausible trio. Build a candidate ledger before choosing: retain the strongest affinity-perfect line found for each available non-Siege troop type, the strongest explicit producer/payoff line, the strongest objective-specific line, and a counter-specific line when an enemy is known. A single line may satisfy multiple categories, but every retained line must be evaluated under the same progression and evidence gates.

Trace producer-to-payoff chains only through abilities active at the reported Star rank, level, and Habit skill level. For the same dragon, a higher Star rank expands or preserves its eligible kit and can unlock additional synergies; do not turn that into a cross-dragon ranking. Unknown Habit skill level means unknown value or reliability, not Level 1 or maximum.
Choose exactly one Vanguard after comparing all three Vanguard abilities, then honor directional flank beneficiaries and exact target scopes.

Choose one troop type for the trio. Before calling any type affinity-perfect, compute the exact intersection of the three dragons' canonical positive-affinity sets; only types in that intersection qualify. Evaluate all three positive and negative affinities separately from enemy troop advantage and objective-specific Siege value.
Classify pivotal effects on trigger certainty and prerequisites, use the actual Habit skill track, and compare opening Rounds 1-10 with later cycles when sustained combat is plausible.
Compare the leading line with the strongest credible alternative. Preserve a defensible alternative when evidence does not establish one winner; state the assumption that would reverse the choice.

candidate_search.full_roster_ledger: When the full roster is in scope and Power is unknown or comparable, inspect every eligible dragon before finalizing the shortlist. For each non-Siege troop type, retain the strongest credible affinity-perfect trio if one exists; separately retain the strongest explicit synergy and objective-specific trios even when they overlap.
candidate_search.lane_permutations: For every retained trio, compare all legal Vanguard choices and directional flank beneficiaries before selecting its best lane order.
candidate_search.pairwise_comparison: Compare retained lines pairwise on the objective profile, unlocked mechanics, reliability, lane value, shared affinity, timing, and known matchup. Record the decisive advantage and material reversal condition internally; do not claim a full-roster optimum from an unreported preselection heuristic.
candidate_search.cross_objective_check: If the same line wins materially different objectives, explicitly verify why the changed objective does not alter the ordering. A generic hybrid must not win attack and survivability prompts merely because it is broadly competent.
candidate_search.benchmark_safety: These search requirements are formation-agnostic. Never seed, boost, or exempt a trio because it appears in an expert benchmark.

visible_power.meaning: Player-specific current viability signal incorporating progression not fully represented by canonical mechanics.
visible_power.use: Apply as a viability anchor and a strong comparison factor among candidates capable of the required job. It does not create missing counter coverage or unlock mechanics.
visible_power.required_disclosure: Explain any omission of a materially higher-Power candidate.

counter_coverage_states.direct: Explicit wording applies to the exact threat instance.
counter_coverage_states.partial: Explicit wording covers only part of the damage category, timing, target set, or trigger.
counter_coverage_states.probabilistic: Coverage depends on a chance-based trigger or uncertain prerequisite.
counter_coverage_states.none: No explicit applicable response; broad role similarity earns no counter credit.

anti_overfitting.benchmark_rule: Use expert formations to diagnose general knowledge, mechanics, search, weighting, context, or presentation gaps; never add formation-name exceptions.
anti_overfitting.holdout_rule: For each meaningful rule change, test at least one variation that changes a lane, troop matchup, Star/Habit gate, Power relationship, or enemy threat.
anti_overfitting.alternative_rule: Do not force benchmark agreement when repository evidence supports a defensible alternative.
